title: Warm Cinnamon Berry Chia Compote Sundae
hookLine: Warm cinnamon-vanilla berry compote thickened naturally with chia over cold Greek yogurt.

items.name: Chia seeds + 1 tbsp pure maple syrup

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {bc_ber} and {bc_chi} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Simmer Berries & Stir Chia Thick
steps.instructionTemplate: Simmer {bc_ber} 5 mins until saucy, stir in {bc_chi}, rest 3 mins to thicken, and spoon warm over chilled yogurt. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.
steps.creatorSecret: Keep the heat on medium-low and whisk constantly around the corners of the saucepan so Warm Cinnamon Berry Chia Compote Sundae thickens velvety smooth without scorching.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {bc_chi} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Warm Cinnamon Berry Chia Compote Sundae coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 4 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 125 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
